name: Trees Are Strictly Rank-Two Ample
scope: Finite classes and finite partial cubes under the survey dictionary.
statement: Every tree is an ample class of VC dimension at most two, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: Trees are maximum classes of VC dimension at most one, hence ample of rank at most two. The square $C_4$ is ample of VC dimension two but is not a tree.
